group.title: Reading comprehension
group.setup: A young engineer joined a company that had used the same paper forms for twenty years. She suggested moving everything to a computer system, but the senior clerks resisted, saying the old way worked fine. Instead of pushing harder, she asked them to list the three tasks they disliked most. All of them named the monthly report, which took two full days to prepare by hand. She built a small tool that produced the report in minutes. After seeing the result, the clerks themselves asked what else could be moved to the computer.
